## Anthropic Claude Activities

Overview of the Claude Compliance API Activity Feed ingested into Microsoft Sentinel.

`TimeGenerated` is the time the activity actually occurred (from `created_at`), not the time Sentinel ingested it. The feed is at-least-once, so counts here are deduplicated on `ActivityId` where it matters.

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| summarize Activities = dcount(ActivityId), Actors = dcount(ActorUserId), ActivityTypes = dcount(ActivityType), Organizations = dcount(OrganizationId)
content.title: Volume summary

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| summarize Activities = dcount(ActivityId) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ActorType
| render timechart
content.title: Activity over time by actor type

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| summarize Activities = dcount(ActivityId) by ActivityType
| top 20 by Activities desc
| render barchart
content.title: Top 20 activity types

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| where isnotempty(ActorEmailAddress)
| summarize Activities = dcount(ActivityId), Types = dcount(ActivityType), SourceIps = dcount(ActorIpAddress) by ActorEmailAddress, ActorUserId
| top 25 by Activities desc
content.title: Most active users

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| where ActorType in ("admin_api_key_actor", "scim_directory_sync_actor") or isnotempty(AdminApiKeyId) or isnotempty(RoleId) or isnotempty(GroupId)
| project TimeGenerated, ActivityType, ActorType, ActorEmailAddress, ActorIpAddress, AdminApiKeyId, RoleId, GroupId, TargetEmailAddress
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Administrative and identity actions

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| where ActorType == "unauthenticated_user_actor"
| summarize Attempts = count(), DistinctEmails = dcount(ActorEmailAddress) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render columnchart
content.title: Pre-authentication activity trend

content.query:
ClaudeActivity_CL
| summarize Events = count(), Distinct = dcount(ActivityId), P50LagSeconds = percentile(todouble(datetime_diff('second', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated)), 50) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| extend DuplicateRate = round(todouble(Events - Distinct) / todouble(Events), 4)
| project TimeGenerated, Events, Distinct, DuplicateRate, P50LagSeconds
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Connector health: ingestion lag and duplicate rate
